QuestInfo.name: Lip-Warmer Confidential
QuestInfo.0: Find Spiegelmann and see what he's so excited about.
QuestInfo.1: Find the phone booth to place Spiegelmann's order.
QuestInfo.2: Spiegelmann's order to the Moustache Factory has been placed. As a bonus, you now know that a Moustache Factory exists and somehow stays in business!

0.0: Such a lovely day! It's sunny outside, highlighting the beauty of the world... but... but I... I'm so ugly! Won't you take time to help an ugly old wretch like me?

yes.0: Ah ha, I knew I could get you to help! There's a phone number and an item number on the note I just gave you. Take that to a phone booth and make the order for me. Can't have the Spiegelmann name out on the wires, if you know what I mean.

no.0: Excellent, just go and get me a... HEY! You think you're so great with your adorable face?!  You're not better than me!!

npc.0: The phone booth is on the  lower side of Edelstein. Why are you still standing here?

lost.0: Make sure you take the note! 'Never trust someone who gets hit in the head for a living to memorize a phone number.' That's what I always say.
